door.alley.description: A service door opening onto an alley.
door.alley.name: alley door
door.alley_back.description: This same service door, seen from the alley: it leads to the back room.
door.alley_back.name: service door
door.automatic_sliding.description: A glass door that slides open by itself as you approach.
door.automatic_sliding.name: automatic door
door.back.description: The same door, seen from inside: it leads outside.
door.back.name: way back
door.clock_tower_backdoor.description: An old service door whose metal parts wear a layer of ancient rust.
door.clock_tower_backdoor.name: clock tower back door
door.clock_tower_ladder.description: A tall aluminium-alloy ladder used to move between the levels of the clock tower. It looks old, but still sturdy.
door.clock_tower_ladder.name: metal ladder
door.club.description: A tidy entrance, guarded by a strict dress code.
door.club.dresscode_refused: This entrance is reserved for chic attire.
door.club.name: club entrance
door.default.name: door
door.default.shop_hours_refusal: The shop only opens its doors between 8am and 8pm.
door.exit.description: A wooden door left ajar, cool air drifting in from outside.
door.exit.name: exit door
door.main_headframe.description: A tall steel frame eaten away by rust towers over the old main extraction shaft. Beneath the great motionless wheel, a mesh cage still hangs from the end of its cables, swaying above a shaft of utter darkness.
door.main_headframe.name: main headframe
door.main_room_door.description: A door leading to the main hall.
door.main_room_door.name: main room door
door.manhole_cover.description: A heavy round metal plate covering the opening of a manhole that leads down to the city sewers.
door.manhole_cover.name: manhole cover
door.mayor_office.description: A brass plate on the door displays the mayor's full name in plain lettering: “Amaryllis Grenat”.
door.mayor_office.name: mayor's office door
door.meeting_room.description: A door leading to the meeting room.
door.meeting_room.name: meeting room door
door.quasar_bazaar.description: A pair of wide automatic glass doors leading outside.
door.quasar_bazaar_entrance.closed_descr: An entrance guarded by a heavy metal roller shutter.
door.quasar_bazaar_entrance.description: Above a pair of wide automatic doors, a midnight-blue sign with white and gold lettering reads “Quasar Bazaar”. Stylized stars and comets adorn the glass panel of the doors.
door.quasar_bazaar_entrance.name: Quasar Bazaar entrance
door.storeroom.description: A discreet door leading to the storeroom.
door.storeroom.name: storeroom door
door.town_hall_main.description: The town hall's front door. It is tall, made of pale wood, with diamond-paned glass.
door.town_hall_main.name: town hall door
door.town_hall_main.time_refusal: The town hall only opens its doors between 8am and 8pm.
entity.bird.description: A bird that chirps every so often.
entity.bird.name: bird
entity.broken_computer.description: A computer tower and its screen, badly damaged and plainly beyond use.
entity.broken_computer.name: broken computer
entity.bush.description: A thick bush. Sometimes there's something in it.
entity.bush.name: bush
entity.chair.description: A wooden chair with a straw seat.
entity.chair.name: chair
entity.cliff_foot.description: Above you, the cliff stretches up several dozen meters of layered rock.
entity.cliff_foot.name: foot of the cliff
entity.clock.description: A wall clock with a circular wooden frame and golden hands. It's {hour}:{minute}.
entity.clock.name: clock
entity.clock_tower_escapement.descriptio: A heavy pendulum beats the measure, each swing releasing one notch of the mechanism with a deep click. This is the true heart of the tower's clockwork.
entity.clock_tower_escapement.name: escapement
entity.clocktower.description: An octagonal tower of old stone, weathered brown by the centuries. Some twenty meters tall, it stands beside the town hall, overlooking the town square.
entity.clocktower.name: clock tower
entity.crate.consumed_description: A wooden crate, emptied of its contents.
entity.crate.name: crate
entity.cumulo_lupus.description: A wolf made of mist and smoke, only seen — or heard — through supernatural perception.
entity.cumulo_lupus.name: Cumulo Lupus
entity.decor.name: piece of scenery
entity.default_statue.name: statue
entity.defective_neon.description: This neon tube doesn't seem to be working properly, as if it were vibrating under some current other than electricity.
entity.defective_neon.name: defective neon
entity.diesel_electric_generator.descrip: A bulky machine made up of a combustion engine, an alternator and a fuel tank, designed to turn fuel into electricity.
entity.diesel_electric_generator.name: generator
entity.dog.name: dog
entity.fountain.name: fountain
entity.ghost.description: An indistinct presence, only revealed by supernatural perception.
entity.ghost.name: presence
entity.ghosten.description: The blurred, uncertain shape of a stooped human silhouette whose arms, tubular and endless, hang down to the ground, where they sink in without any logic. The light sources filtering through this apparition take on a vibrance at times spectral, at times electric.
entity.ghosten.name: ghosten
entity.glass_window.name: window
entity.highway_traffic.description: A lane carrying an unbroken flow of cars and other vehicles. Be careful when crossing.
entity.highway_traffic.name: road
entity.hound.description: A stray dog you can hear barking in the distance, every so often.
entity.hound.name: stray dog
entity.item.description: An object, sitting on the ground.
entity.item.name: object to pick up
entity.large_machinery.description: An imposing assembly of gears and other metal parts, tirelessly turning with a heavy sound.
entity.large_machinery.name: heavy machinery
entity.large_winding_mechanism.descripti: A squat mechanism hoists the counterweight in steady jerks, an arm lifting the load in a patient, endless motion. It is what keeps time from stopping.
entity.large_winding_mechanism.name: winding mechanism
entity.machine_1.description: An electrical installation that vibrates, heats up and roars to do its job.
entity.machine_1.name: machine
entity.metal_container.description: A massive crate made entirely of sturdy metal.
entity.metal_container.name: metal container
entity.metal_fence.description: A tall wire mesh wall looks sturdy.
entity.metal_fence.name: wire fence
entity.metal_trash_can.description: A metal trash can pitted with rust.
entity.metal_trash_can.name: metal trash can
entity.miravi.description: The shadow of a bird of prey whose skin gives off diffuse, crystalline glimmers. Its wingspan is as striking as the many sources of light that seem trapped in its body of glass.
entity.miravi.name: miravi
entity.money.description: A bit of money, sitting on the ground.
entity.money.name: money
entity.mop_and_bucket.description: A plain metal bucket with a wooden-handled mop resting in it.
entity.mop_and_bucket.name: mop and bucket
entity.motorised_billboard.name: motorized billboard
entity.neon.name: neon sign
entity.npc.name: character
entity.object.name: object
entity.office_chair.description: A modern, ergonomic seat with armrests, casters and a tall padded backrest.
entity.office_chair.name: office chair
entity.office_computer.description: A sleek, modern setup made up of a tower, a flat screen, a keyboard, a mouse, and a pair of speakers.
entity.office_computer.name: desktop computer
entity.office_supply_box.description: A faded, plastic-coated cardboard box holding an assortment of pens, staples, markers and other mass-produced sticky notes.
entity.office_supply_box.name: box of office supplies
entity.office_table.description: A plain, long table made of a light wooden top on bare metal legs. A hole closed by a plastic cover lets wires and cables through.
entity.office_table.name: meeting table
entity.office_water_cooler.description: A tall dispenser topped with a huge bottle of water.
entity.office_water_cooler.name: water cooler
entity.old_quarries_pond.description: A pond a few meters deep, formed by whole seasons of rain fallen on one of the excavation areas.
entity.old_quarries_pond.name: quarry pond
entity.old_survey_map.description: A large map of the town, rolled up and yellowed, covered in faded ink annotations.
entity.old_survey_map.name: old survey map
entity.old_survey_map.taken: You take the old survey map.
entity.perched_bird.description: A small bird hopping about, pecking at the ground.
entity.perched_bird.name: bird
entity.potted_plant.description: A terracotta pot holding a very common plant species.
entity.potted_plant.name: potted plant
entity.reversed_clock_tower_escapement.d: Watching this pendulum's unnatural swing for too long slowly fills the mind with a terrible sense of doom.
A mechanism that defies logic, its powerful arm pulling the huge weights downwards as if to tear them from the sky. It seems to be under phenomenal strain.
entity.reversed_weight_shaft.description: Strange, repulsive organic cables carry the heavy weights up towards a hole in the heights of the room, in a complete absence of logic.
entity.reversed_weight_shaft.name: inverted shaft
entity.river.description: The river's waters are murky, but calm.
entity.river.name: river
entity.rock.name: boulder
entity.shellter_statue.description: An impressively large statue depicting a giant sea turtle carrying several houses on its shell. Its stone is old, but clean and well kept.
entity.shellter_statue.name: statue of Shellter
entity.shop_counter.description: A sales counter with its cash drawer. You can sell what you carry here.
entity.shop_counter.name: counter
entity.shop_display.description: A piece of furniture meant to showcase an item, currently empty.
entity.shop_display.name: display stand
entity.sound_emitter.name: sound emitter
entity.storm_drain.description: A dark metal grate set at the foot of a sidewalk to carry rainwater down to the city sewers.
entity.storm_drain.name: storm drain
entity.traffic_light.description: A tall metal pole topped by a head whose lights, green, red or amber, turn on in turn to guide the traffic. At adult height, a big button activates the crossing sound signal.
entity.traffic_light.name: traffic light
entity.turret_clockwork.description: A huge electrical cabinet with a dial showing the time to the millisecond: {hour}:{minute}.
entity.turret_clockwork.name: clock tower timer
entity.video_projection.description: The luminous projection of a video feed cast by a nearby device.
entity.video_projection.name: video projection
entity.video_projector.description: A noisy device used to project a video feed onto a blank surface. Compact as it is, it vibrates and blows hard.
entity.video_projector.name: video projector
entity.wall_air_conditioner.description: A huge block of metal whose grilled mouth spits out hot air.
entity.wall_air_conditioner.name: wall air conditioner
entity.weight_shaft.description: A thick steel cable vanishes into a vertical shaft, creeping slowly down into the depths of the tower in a series of jolts. Somewhere below, one senses the mass of a counterweight pulling it along.
entity.weight_shaft.name: counterweight shaft
entity.wind_chime.description: A pretty arrangement of hanging tubes, rods, and other strips that the wind knocks together into a distinctive song.
entity.wind_chime.name: wind chime
entity.wood_bench.description: A sturdy bench with a metal frame and long wooden slats, with room for two or three people to sit.
entity.wood_bench.name: wooden bench
magic_mirror.default.description: Despite the grime and cracks covering its surface, the mirror gives off an uneven silvery shimmer. It does not reflect the room you are standing in.
magic_mirror.default.name: magic mirror
magic_mirror.default.pass_refusal: The mirror sends back a reflection warped by grime, cracks and quicksilver light.
mirror.default.description: A large wall mirror that looks out of place here. Its surface is grimy and crossed with cracks.
mirror.default.name: wall mirror
npc.guard.description: A guard watching the room without a word.
npc.guard.name: guard
npc.merchant.name: merchant
npc.passerby.description: A passerby muttering to themselves, paying you no attention.
npc.passerby.name: passerby
npc.resident.description: A local resident, going about their day.
npc.resident.name: resident
object.toolbox.description: A metal toolbox. It looks like it can be searched.
object.toolbox.name: toolbox
passage.clock_tower.description: A discreet passage running along the base of the clock tower.
passage.default.description: A narrow passage to the other side of the place.
passage.default.name: passage
passage.main_street_sidewalk.description: A wide sidewalk running along the main block of the shopping street.
passage.old_quarries_excavations.descrip: For lack of upkeep, this way between two excavation areas has become treacherous and chaotic, almost dangerous to take.
passage.old_quarries_fence.description: A walkable path runs between the foot of the fence and the first boulder fields of the nearest quarry.
passage.town_hall.description: A shaded passage running along the town hall building.
passage.town_hall_meeting_room.descripti: A gap left between the wall and the chairs that lets you cross the meeting room.
scene_exit.default.description: The way carries on towards another part of town.
scene_exit.default.name: exit
scene_exit.main_street_town_square.descr: The street opens onto the town square.
scene_exit.main_street_town_square.name: towards the town square
scene_exit.town_square_main_street.descr: The square leads on to main street.
scene_exit.town_square_main_street.name: towards main street
